{"test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection1", "test_code": "#nullable enable\n\nusing System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Emit;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection1\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ReferencedAssemblyTypeFormatter_HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute()\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> references = frameworkRefs.AddRange(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        string referencedSource = @\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace ReferencedLibrary\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class ExternalData\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Id { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(1)]\n        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;\n    }\n}\n\";\n\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest);\n\n        CSharpCompilation referencedCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"ReferencedLibrary\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(referencedSource, parseOptions) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        using MemoryStream referencedStream = new MemoryStream();\n        EmitResult emitResult = referencedCompilation.Emit(referencedStream);\n        Assert.True(emitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics));\n\n        MetadataReference referencedAssembly = MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(referencedStream.ToArray());\n\n        string consumerSource = @\"\nusing MessagePack;\nusing ReferencedLibrary;\n\nnamespace ConsumerApp\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class LocalData\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public ExternalData External { get; set; } = new ExternalData();\n    }\n}\n\";\n\n        CSharpCompilation consumerCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"ConsumerApp\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(consumerSource, parseOptions) },\n            references.Add(referencedAssembly),\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(consumerCompilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.Empty(runResult.Diagnostics);\n        foreach (GeneratorRunResult result in runResult.Results)\n        {\n            Assert.Null(result.Exception);\n        }\n\n        Assert.Empty(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? externalDataSymbol = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"ReferencedLibrary.ExternalData\");\n        Assert.NotNull(externalDataSymbol);\n        Assert.Empty(externalDataSymbol!.DeclaringSyntaxReferences);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterInterfaceSymbol = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.Formatters.IMessagePackFormatter`1\");\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterInterfaceSymbol);\n        INamedTypeSymbol expectedInterface = formatterInterfaceSymbol!.Construct(externalDataSymbol);\n\n        List<INamedTypeSymbol> generatedTypes = GetAllNamedTypes(outputCompilation.Assembly.GlobalNamespace);\n        INamedTypeSymbol? externalFormatterSymbol = generatedTypes.FirstOrDefault(\n            t => t.AllInterfaces.Contains(expectedInterface, SymbolEqualityComparer.Default));\n        Assert.NotNull(externalFormatterSymbol);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? excludeFromCodeCoverageSymbol = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n        Assert.NotNull(excludeFromCodeCoverageSymbol);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\n            externalFormatterSymbol!.GetAttributes(),\n            attr => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(attr.AttributeClass, excludeFromCodeCoverageSymbol));\n    }\n\n    private static List<INamedTypeSymbol> GetAllNamedTypes(INamespaceSymbol rootNamespace)\n    {\n        List<INamedTypeSymbol> result = new List<INamedTypeSymbol>();\n        Stack<INamespaceOrTypeSymbol> stack = new Stack<INamespaceOrTypeSymbol>();\n        stack.Push(rootNamespace);\n\n        while (stack.Count > 0)\n        {\n            INamespaceOrTypeSymbol current = stack.Pop();\n            if (current is INamespaceSymbol ns)\n            {\n                foreach (INamespaceSymbol childNs in ns.GetNamespaceMembers())\n                {\n                    stack.Push(childNs);\n                }\n\n                foreach (INamedTypeSymbol childType in ns.GetTypeMembers())\n                {\n                    stack.Push(childType);\n                }\n            }\n            else if (current is INamedTypeSymbol type)\n            {\n                result.Add(type);\n                foreach (INamedTypeSymbol nestedType in type.GetTypeMembers())\n                {\n                    stack.Push(nestedType);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        return result;\n    }\n}\n"}
